properties.evidence: The earlier one saw this coming, from the other side. That finding measured that vocabulary reaches a user's design only with a typed tool, an instruction, and a detector that notices absence. This is the inverse failure: the instruction EXISTS and claims the case, but costs more than the thing being captured, so the vocabulary still never gets written. Reach is not only about whether a leg is present — an instruction heavy enough to be skipped is a leg that does not bear weight.
